title: More model choice, fewer lost reference images
summary:
New text models, 3D and React SDK tools, two community games, and a round of fixes for images, streams, and the UI.

Lightning Text v2 and v2.1 were added with image input, JSON output, and tool calling. Image work now forwards the supported number of reference images to MAI and Grok Imagine, while Qwen Image 3 Pro’s fallback stays on the Pro model. Claude routing now prefers Anthropic with AWS Bedrock as fallback.

The SDK gained 3D generation, model status, and speech word timings; its React package gained generation hooks and a streaming transport for Vercel AI SDK’s useChat. CLI and REST-agent device sign-in became easier to guide, while MCP balance and model errors became more accurate. Sandbox templates got smaller, and the per-user running-sandbox cap rose from three to eight.

Model Match asks players to identify which AI wrote an anonymous answer, using pre-generated rounds that need no API key to play. Tiny Fighter Arena turns a one-line description into a drawn fighter with moves, stats, and a battle to enter.

highlights.title: Lightning Text v2.1
highlights.text: Use `inferenceport-ai/lightning-text-v2.1` with text or image input, JSON output, and tool calling. It requires paid Pollen. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=inferenceport-ai/lightning-text-v2.1).

highlights.title: 3D in the SDK
highlights.text: Generate binary 3D output with `model3d()`, discover 3D models with `models("3d")`, and get typed model status and speech word timings in the SDK alpha. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: React generation hooks
highlights.text: The React SDK now has hooks for image, text, audio, video, and transcription generation, plus a streaming transport for Vercel AI SDK’s `useChat`. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: Guess the model
highlights.text: Read an anonymous AI answer and guess which of four models wrote it. Five rounds, no API key needed. [Try it](https://patbing.github.io/model-match).

highlights.title: Make a tiny fighter
highlights.text: Describe a fighter in one line, then see AI give it a portrait, moves, stats, and a battle. [Try it](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-fighter-arena).
